page.layout: One page of text: verse lines, running head at top left, page number at top right. Signature at lower right of the text.

main_text.p: Num ciues crebris attritos cladibus ista Exhauriunt hirudines? Francisci frustra mens canit prouida regis Hæc ominata posteris. Nati, Guisiadas, fatalia nomina, dixit, Arcete vestris finibus. Exitio crescent vestro, populique ruinis Caput tollent superbius. O mala quanta ferent! audaces funera quanta Genti mouebunt Francia! Non patria flammas, Helenē cum duxit adulter Damnosiores intulit. Non dedit Ausoniæ graniora[?] incommoda dirus Carthaginensis Annibal. Hæc memores olim prædicta renoluite, Galli, Quæ tristis euentus probat. Et vestris tandem satiati cladibus, atque Luctu ruentis patriæ, Non fraude, ast Francum vera virtute, superbi Malis carere quaerite. Magnates veterum cretos de sanguine Regum, & Gallos fouete nobiles. Gallos Gallus amat pro rege perire paratus, Pro chariore patria. Ad fines verum si spes deducet auara Vestros vagantes hospites, Excipere ignotos solita lenitate cauete, Cauete fraudes exteras.

page.notes: The line "Non dedit Ausoniæ graniora incommoda dirus" is uncertain at "graniora"; it may be "graviora". The signature "C. iiij." is read with doubt at the final letters. The word "Helenē" carries a tilde over the final e as printed.
